result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. The added migration examples are reasonably within transition assistance and do not alter unrelated commercial terms. Drafting is generally professional, though Section 4.3 is placed after Section 10.7 rather than with Article 4, and adding Section 4.3 to the survival clause would provide greater certainty that the post-termination obligations remain enforceable.
